title: Alex Vacca GTM channel-order playbook: warm-before-email lift
summary: Frontal founder Alex Vacca argues B2B GTM should sequence channels: exhaust one outbound motion, add founder LinkedIn, wire warm-content viewers into email before a third channel, then monetize delivery assets. Same 1,000-email test tripled deals when prospects had seen content 3+ times.
question_it_answers: In what order should B2B outbound, LinkedIn, and signal targeting be layered for compounding reply rates?

claims.text: Repeating the same 1,000 cold emails tripled deals when the batch had already seen the sender's content 3+ times.
claims.evidence: The second run produced 3 deals, because that batch had already seen our content 3+ times before the email arrived
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Founder LinkedIn from a personal profile booked over 1,000 meetings in one year while the company page did little.
claims.evidence: Ours booked over 1,000 meetings in a single year while the company page did basically nothing.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Signal campaigns targeting account changes yield 5–11% reply rates versus 3–5% for title-based lists.
claims.evidence: That's where the 5 to 11% reply rates on our signal campaigns come from while everyone else sits at 3 to 5%.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

numbers.label: LinkedIn meetings booked in one year
